 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Thunder are set to take on the Portland Trail Blazers tonight, which should offer another test in a tough Western Conference .
 OKC has course-corrected since back-to-back losses against Texas opponents, winning four-straight games. Even with injuries to several major players, the Thunder have enough in the tank to compete with most teams, and that should include Portland.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement So far, the Trail Blazers have overachieved so far this season, getting out to a hot start with its new-look roster.
 Here are the injury reports for both the Thunder and Trail Blazers ahead of tonight's game:
 OKC Thunder injuries: 
 Chet Holmgren - Out: Right knee injury recovery 
 Thomas Sorber - Out: Right knee surgery 
 Nikola Topic - Out: G League 
 Cason Wallace - Out: Left shoulder surgery 
 Jalen Williams - Out: Left ankle surgery 
 Jaylin Wiliams - Out: Low back spasms 
 Portland Trail Blazers injuries: 
 Jayson Kent - Out: G League 
 Vit Krejci - Out: Left ankle fracture 
 Ja Morant - Out: Left hamstring strain 
 Shaedon Sharpe - Out: Right meniscus surgery 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement John Tonje - Out: G League 
 The OKC Thunder continue to deal with injuries this season, despite their run of success. Its listed six players on its injury report ahead of Portland, will all six listed out.
 The team lost three players against the Clippers in Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Chet Holmgren. The former two underwent surgery for respective injuries, with only Holmgren certain to make his return this season. The team's star center is expected to be sideline for 8-10 weeks following a knee injury.
 Also out due to injury are Jaylin Williams, who has now dealt with back spasms for a handful of games, as well as Thomas Sorber, who has yet to make his debut following a major knee injury.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Nikola Topic is still listed as out, but has made his return from a back surgery over the offseason, playing in two G League games with the OKC Blue. It's been clear that he's not yet ready for NBA minutes, but he's begun to shake the rust off.
 The Trail Blazers are dealing with injuries of their own, listing five players in total. Star guard Ja Morant is out due to a hamstring strain, as well as budding wing Shaedon Sharpe. Also listed is former Thunder wing Vit Krejci, as well as two G League players.
 The Thunder and Trail Blazers tip off tonight at 10 p.m. CT from Portland, OR.
